sections.title: About
intro: I'm a technologist, educator, and free software advocate who helps people solve problems with open technologies—from building technical solutions to growing communities of practice—because I believe we should all own the technology we depend on.

I train teams in open geospatial, programming, open data, and AI; move organizations to open tools and fix their data workflows; and build maps, applications, data platforms, and data pipelines on open software.

Above all, I help people and organizations stay current and literate in data, technology, and AI, so they make their own informed decisions rather than let the myths, hype, and upsells decide for them.

entries.title: [Python Essentials, Arrays, and DataFrames](https://www.facebook.com/bnhr.xyz/posts/pfbid0d1bwxuv9twcGKTUsrbPzPjrvBGmAivkxhJT16BjgQ1XSgY71Wy7duyAXaE7q2Fj7l)
